scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:sqlite: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma','prisma/schema.prisma');if(!fs.existsSync('.env'))fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env');fs.closeSync(fs.openSync('prisma/dev.db','a'))" && prisma db push && echo Switched to SQLite (local)
scripts.db:pg: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('prisma/schema.pg.prisma','prisma/schema.prisma')" && prisma db push && prisma generate && echo Switched to PostgreSQL and synchronized schema
